content.what_it_is: No-argument MATLAB configuration function that defines frequency/direction counts, wave/spectrum parameters, depth/gravity, phase inclusion, and coherent percentage (L1-L24); clamps coherent percentage into 0-100, rounds mean direction to one decimal degree, and saves its entire local workspace to inputs.mat in the current directory (L26-L35).
entities: frequency count mfreq defined at L3
wave-component count mcomponent defined from mfreq at L4
direction count mtheta defined at L5
wave height Hmo defined at L7
peak/min/max frequencies fp/fmax/fmin defined at L8-L10
spectral coefficient gamma_spec defined at L11
mean direction theta_mean defined at L12 and reassigned at L33
directional spread sigma_theta defined at L13
depth and gravity g defined at L15-L16
phase flag phase_include defined at L20
coherent percentage Coherent_Percentage defined at L24 and clamped at L28/L30

params_defined.name: mfreq
params_defined.range: positive frequency count implied but not checked

equations.ref: one component count per configured frequency
round mean direction to one decimal degree

verbatim_spans.text: %% Twin percentage must be within 0 to 100 percent

unresolved: Hidden-state interface at L1 and L35: the function returns no values and serializes its whole local workspace to a fixed current-directory inputs.mat. Consumers must load implicit variable names, and an existing file is overwritten without a target path/version/schema check.

Cross-file feasibility risk: Coherent_Percentage=100 and mcomponent=mfreq=1125 at L3-L4/L24 feed the gate-read Coherence_Spectrum selection loop, whose pool excludes host frequencies. Reaching all 1125 coherent entries requires every host to acquire a guest before the guest pool empties; this configuration does not validate that against host count/placement.

The clamp at L27-L31 validates only Coherent_Percentage. mfreq/mtheta/mcomponent positivity and integrality, fmin<fp<fmax, depth/g positivity, sigma_theta nonzero, and phase_include domain are not checked before persistence.
Copy/rename inconsistency at L24-L26: the variable and preceding comment describe coherent wave components, but the bound comment calls it 'Twin percentage'; no Twin variable exists.

mcomponent is set equal only to mfreq at L4 while a separate mtheta=25 is defined at L5; whether wave components should include the direction dimension is not explained, yet downstream coherent count uses mcomponent.
